roundNote: Round 13 tests the fix for round 12's two failures (ea39694f). fold-plan warns about an orphan fragment and still plans. A new release-push.sh fold-orphans refuses one, run in ci.yaml's lint job. The package list moved from changelog-fold.yaml's CHANGELOG_PACKAGES env into .github/changelog-packages. I also checked the architect's three move items (Envoy ee7df043). Migrations, stores and scripts/conflicts are unchanged since 75680e45, so round 11's proofs of them still apply. I added one commit to my own red test, e384dad8, which only updates its comment to name the new file.

implementerProof.how: I drove both fixes on real trees at ea39694f: the lint step's command and the fold step's command, each on the clean tree and on a branch that adds packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml. I re-ran release-push.test.sh (my red test included), check-release-credentials.sh and its test, and check-ci-filters.sh. I compared the new list file with the old env value, and grepped the tree for the old name. Every claim holds.

proof.criterion: (A) A pull request that adds a fragment of a package the fold does not fold fails a required check (round 12 failure A)
proof.surface: ci.yaml's lint job step 'Check every changelog fragment belongs to a package the fold folds', run as written on real trees; the ruleset and ci-ok
proof.command: in worktrees of ea39694f, clean and with packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml committed: bash -c '.github/scripts/release-push.sh fold-orphans $(<.github/changelog-packages)'; read lint's if: and ci-ok's needs and comment in ci.yaml
proof.observed: clean: exit 0, silent. With the orphan: exit 1, '::error::release-push.sh fold-orphans: packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml at HEAD: each is under the .changes/ of a package the fold was not given…'. lint runs on every non-draft pull request (if: !cancelled() && !draft), and ci-ok, one of the ruleset's two required contexts, needs lint and requires it to succeed on every change (ci.yaml:3150). So the refusal now fails a required check
proof.negativeControl: round 12: the refusal ran only in changelog-fold.yaml's fold_build, which no required context needs

proof.criterion: (B) An orphan fragment that reaches main does not stop the fold of the packages it can fold, and is named (round 12 failure B)
proof.surface: changelog-fold.yaml's 'Plan the fold' step command, run as written on real trees; release-push.test.sh
proof.command: same two worktrees: bash -c 'packages=$(<.github/changelog-packages); .github/scripts/release-push.sh fold-plan $packages'; bash .github/scripts/release-push.test.sh
proof.observed: clean: exit 0, 23 plan lines across 7 packages, empty stderr. With the orphan: exit 0, the same 23 lines across 7 packages, and stderr '::warning::release-push.sh fold-plan: packages/daemon/.changes/unreleased/x.yaml at HEAD: …'. release-push.test.sh: 635 passed, 0 failed, including my red test 'an orphan fragment on main does not stop the plan of the packages the fold is given', whose assertion is unchanged since a26683995f0f
proof.negativeControl: the same red test failed at 7fbb983f (628 passed, 1 failed), where one orphan made fold-plan exit 1 with no plan

proof.criterion: The package list's move: every fold job gets the same seven entries, and the credentialed job reads the file with no dependency code (architect item 1)
proof.surface: .github/changelog-packages and the three changelog-fold.yaml steps that read it (fold_build's plan and render steps, fold_publish's 'Fold and push' with the deploy key)
proof.command: diff of the old CHANGELOG_PACKAGES value at 4eb8b6cb, split to one word per line, against .github/changelog-packages; bash -c 'set -- $(<.github/changelog-packages); echo $#'; read fold_publish's steps
proof.observed: identical: the same seven specs, in the same order. Word splitting of $(<file) gives 7 arguments, packages/pi-legion=pi-legion-v … packages/envoy-client. All three steps read it with packages=$(<.github/changelog-packages), a bash redirection. fold_publish runs actions/checkout, actions/download-artifact and that one run step, which calls release-push.sh push-fold: no bun, go, node or other dependency code
proof.negativeControl: with that step's read changed to $(bun -e …; cat .github/changelog-packages), check-release-credentials.sh exits 1: 'job fold_publish holds a credential, but step Fold and push runs bun'

proof.criterion: check-release-credentials.sh and check-ci-filters.sh exit 0 at the head (architect item 2)
proof.surface: the two checks the lint job runs, on a worktree of ea39694f
proof.command: bash .github/scripts/check-release-credentials.sh; bash .github/scripts/check-release-credentials.test.sh; uv run --no-project --with pyyaml==6.0.2 -- bash .github/scripts/check-ci-filters.sh
proof.observed: credentials: exit 0, '7 credentialed job(s) and 10 build job(s) across 5 workflows keep credentials out of jobs that run dependency code'; its test PASS; filters: exit 0, 29 gates
proof.negativeControl: the bun mutation above fails the credentials check

proof.criterion: Every guide that named changelog-fold.yaml's CHANGELOG_PACKAGES now names .github/changelog-packages (architect item 3)
proof.surface: the whole tree at this head
proof.command: grep -rn CHANGELOG_PACKAGES outside .legion; grep -n changelog-packages AGENTS.md; grep the *.md files for 'changelog-fold.yaml … lists/names' and 'seven packages'
proof.observed: AGENTS.md:539 reads 'the seven packages `.github/changelog-packages` lists …, the one list the fold and the check below both read'. The only CHANGELOG_PACKAGES left are check-release-credentials.test.sh's synthetic fold-workflow fixture (lines 370-422 and 1345), which is no guide and still passes, and my own red test's comment, which I updated in e384dad8. No other guide names the list
proof.negativeControl: the same grep at 4eb8b6cb finds AGENTS.md naming CHANGELOG_PACKAGES in changelog-fold.yaml
